sources.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: In this technical report, we outline the different model architectures across model sizes as well as the pre-training and post-training recipe of Gemma 4. Through comprehensive benchmarks and human evaluations such as Arena (Chiang et al., 2024), we demonstrate that Gemma 4 operates at a level comparable to larger, frontier open-source models ...
